Who is Kazi Musharraf?
Kazi Musharraf, also known as Musharraf Ateeque Kazi and mk-knight23, is an India-based AI Engineer, full-stack developer and independent builder. He previously worked at Wipro Technologies as a Project Engineer from July 2022 to July 2025.

What can I hire Kazi to build?

What does a forward-deployed approach mean here?
Understand the users and their workflow, define a small useful outcome, build a demonstrable version, verify behavior, deploy and document handover. This is a delivery approach and role interest, not a claim of having held a formal FDE title.

Can consulting be discussed in USD or AED?
Yes. Project scope, budget, payment terms, milestones, availability and handover are agreed before work begins. No fixed rate or service guarantee is implied by this portfolio.
